title: A phase 3 efficacy and safety study of fosmanogepix for the treatment of adult patients with invasive mold infections
official: An interventional Phase 3, open-label, two-cohort study to investigate the efficacy and safety of fosmanogepix in adult patients with invasive mold infections caused by Aspergillus spp., Fusarium spp., Lomentospora prolificans, Mucorales fungi, or other multidrug resistant molds
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of fosmanogepix for the treatment of adult patients with Invasive mold infections (IMIs) caused by Aspergillus spp. (in patients with limited treatment options), Fusarium spp., Lomentospora prolificans, Mucorales fungi, or other multidrug resistant molds.
conditions: Invasive mold infections caused by Aspergillus spp., Fusarium spp., Lomentospora prolificans, Mucorales fungi, or other multidrug resistant molds
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Diagnosis of proven or probable IMI defined in accordance with the Revision and Update of the Consensus Definitions of Invasive Fungal Disease from the EORTC/MSGERC as adapted for this study and caused by Aspergillus spp. (in patients with limited treatment options), Fusarium spp., Lomentospora prolificans, Mucorales fungi, or other multi-drug resistant molds.
2. 2. Patient’s condition allows for appropriate infection source control measures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Refractory hematologic malignancy.
2. 10. Other medical or psychiatric condition.
3. 11. Current use of any prohibited concomitant medication(s).
4. 12. Current/previous administration of an investigational drug within 30 days.
5. 13. Prior enrollment in this or any previous study of fosmanogepix.
6. 14. Moderate or severe hepatic impairment.
7. 15. Patient who is pregnant or lactating.
8. 16. Known hypersensitivity to fosmanogepix, manogepix, or any of the excipients.
9. 2. Chronic aspergillosis, aspergilloma, or allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis.
10. 3. Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) associated mucormycosis.
11. 4. Invasive fungal disease caused by more than one fungal pathogen are not permitted in Cohort A but are permitted in Cohort B.
12. 5. Patients with a Karnofsky Performance Status < 20 at Screening.
13. 6. Requirement, or anticipated requirement, for hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, or hemofiltration.
14. 7. Patients with known human immunodeficiency virus infection.
15. 8. Ongoing neurological disorders.
16. 9. Patients receiving hospice/comfort care only.
